calls.density: xraydb.atomic_density(symbol) for the pure elements; the preset density otherwise
calls.tableEdge_eV: discontinuity of xraydb's Elam photoabsorption table nearest the listed edge: xraydb.get_xraydb().get_cache('photoabsorption', column='element', value=absorber)
calls.thickness_um: 1e4 / deltaMu_cm_inv, or 3e4 / muAbove_cm_inv when that keeps mu_total * d at or below 3 (limitedBy)

notes: Each material_mu value is checked against the mass-fraction sum of xraydb.mu_elam for the same formula.
xraydb.material_mu matches its materials list by name or by formula ignoring case, so 'CO' would become cobalt; such formulas are passed with explicit counts ('C1O1').
Energies within 1 eV of a listed edge or table discontinuity of any element in the formula are skipped (skipped_eV).
